en: Compute each cell area. \[\Delta x=1,\ \Delta y=\frac{1}{2},\ \Delta A=\frac{1}{2}\]

statement.en: Let V be the volume under \(\sqrt{52-x^2-y^2}\) over \([2,4]\times[2,6]\). Split at x=3,y=4 and let L and U use lower-left and upper-right samples. Order V,L,U without evaluating them.

en: On this positive rectangle the function decreases when either coordinate increases.
Each cell has its maximum at the lower-left and minimum at the upper-right. Thus L overestimates and U underestimates; the inequalities are strict on interior points.

statement.ko: \(f(x,y)=(x-y)/(x+y)^3\)에 대해 단위 정사각형의 dy dx와 dx dy 반복적분을 각각 계산하고 값이 다른 이유를 설명하라.

hint.ko: 영역과 표본점을 먼저 정하고, 안쪽 적분에서는 다른 변수를 상수로 둔다.

ko: 원점에서 함수가 특이하다. 예를 들어 \(0\le y\le x/2\)에서는 \(|f|\ge4/(27x^2)\)이므로 절댓값 이중적분은 \(\int_0^1 dx/x\)처럼 발산한다. 연속성도 절대적분가능성도 없어 Fubini의 가정을 만족하지 않는다.
en: For x>0, a y-antiderivative is \(y/(x+y)^2\), hence \[\int_0^1\int_0^1f\,dy\,dx=\int_0^1\frac{dx}{(1+x)^2}=\frac12\]
For y>0, an x-antiderivative is \(-x/(x+y)^2\), hence \[\int_0^1\int_0^1f\,dx\,dy=-\int_0^1\frac{dy}{(1+y)^2}=-\frac12\]

The origin is singular. On \(0\le y\le x/2\), \(|f|\ge4/(27x^2)\), so the absolute double integral diverges like \(\int_0^1dx/x\). Neither continuity nor absolute integrability holds; Fubini does not apply.

Fubini로 먼저 \(g=\int_c^y\int_a^xf(s,t)dsdt\)로 바꾸면 \(g_y=\int_a^xf(s,y)ds\), 따라서 \(g_{yx}=f(x,y)\)이다. f 자체의 미분가능성은 필요 없다.
en: (a) Both allow the order of two operations in different variables to be exchanged under suitable continuity hypotheses.
(b) The fundamental theorem gives \(g_x=\int_c^yf(x,t)dt\); differentiating in y yields \(g_{xy}=f(x,y)\).
Fubini rewrites \(g=\int_c^y\int_a^xf(s,t)dsdt\). Thus \(g_y=\int_a^xf(s,y)ds\) and \(g_{yx}=f(x,y)\). Differentiability of f itself is unnecessary.
